items.front: Agriculture's share of GVA vs workforce?
items.back: ~18% of GVA but employs ~45-46% of the workforce.

items.front: Kharif vs Rabi vs Zaid — sowing and examples?
items.back: Kharif (rice/cotton, Jun-Jul), Rabi (wheat/gram, Oct-Dec), Zaid (watermelon, summer).
items.examPoint: Cropping seasons
items.source: notes

items.front: Who led India's Green Revolution and with what inputs?
items.back: M.S. Swaminathan (with Borlaug's work); HYV seeds, fertiliser, irrigation (post-1965).

items.source: notes

items.front: Coloured revolutions: White, Blue, Yellow, Pink?

items.examPoint: Coloured revolutions
items.source: notes

items.front: Who led the Bhoodan Movement and when?
